<CLT=cltMIND>I feel as though there are less weapons
here than I remember...

Alright, everyone's here.
I hope you're all ready.
A-Are those weapons...?

So you went to my lab yesterday to find
weapons to use against Monokuma.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's because Kaito had them...

<CLT=cltMIND>I think there are still things
to investigate here...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>As I suspected, there are two black bags
here, identical to the one in the hangar.

<CLT=cltMIND>They're cases for the crossbows.
The crossbows are inside, but disassembled.

It looks as if they don't even fit in the
case unless they're disassembled.

<CLT=cltMIND>But there are two...
When I was here with Kaito before...
<CLT=cltMIND>There were three of them.

<CLT=cltMIND>And I'm sure that Kaito didn't
have a crossbow with him...

In that case...the crossbow in the hangar
*must* have come from here.

<CLT=cltMIND>Which means someone must have
brought it to the hangar from here.

<CLT=cltMIND>But...it's fairly difficult to put
together the crossbow.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't believe you'd be able to
do it unless Maki taught you.

I'll think more about that later, for now
I need to investigate.
